editorial: When to go depends on which version of the salt flats you want. When we visited in October, it was the dry season (July to October).

We were witnessed the vast white salt crust at its finest, while there was still residual water in pockets that produced the mirror effect. The cactus islands, arguably the most picturesque region, are harder to reach during when the water levels rise.
That being said, the peak wet season (January to March) is when you get the giant mirror that’s all over Instagram.
The rest of the year is an awkward time when there’s enough water to interfere with the accessibility, but not enough for the mirror effect.
